subject: Traditional women in saree and dhotis lighting oil lamps and creating intricate flower kolams during a diwali festive celebration by a water body

setting.place: Ancient Tamilakam village temple tank and traditional stone architecture with thatched roofs and palm trees

lighting: Warm, flickering glow from hundreds of terracotta oil lamps, torches, and soft moonlight reflecting on the water
style: Cinematic historical realism, highly detailed digital painting with rich textures and dramatic chiaroscuro lighting
